description: Paired comparison of the published Idol-Q8_0.gguf with a local build that differs from it only in how 96 denoiser matrices are rounded (plain Q8_0 rounding instead of covariance-calibrated codes), scored against original Idol with the GSO32 fidelity protocol.

tensor_comparison.differing_tensors: 24 denoiser blocks x (attn.qkv, attn.out, mlp.0, mlp.2) weights, all Q8_0 in both files
tensor_comparison.metadata_differences: The published file records the denoiser calibration (idol.quantization.tier Q8_0_DENOISER_Q80_COV and the encoded and moment digests); the local file records tier Q8_0.

protocol.source: benchmarks/gso32/protocol.json (same inputs, seeds 0, 42 and 2026, 50 steps, 262,144 Gaussians, synthetic input preprocessing, original encoders)
protocol.runtime: resident GPU, batched guidance, cuDNN attention, fused packed kernels, as in the published run
protocol.reference: the original-Idol latents and meshes retained from the published 96-case run
protocol.mesh: idol_mesh with the protocol settings (resolution 176, sigma 1.5, iso 0.2, min piece 0.05); identical extractor binary (sha256 d43743c5...ac09)

harness_check: The published file was regenerated through the same scoring script for 6 of its cases (2 objects x 3 seeds; 9 generations in all, because the first object was run twice): every latent was bit-identical to the retained one, and the mesh distances, F1 scores and latent errors of the 3 cases checked in full matched the published receipts exactly.
conclusion: No measure shows the local build to be better. Over these 36 cases it is statistically indistinguishable from the published file, with a small non-significant tendency to higher latent error (worse in 23 of 36 cases). The published file was kept and nothing was uploaded.
limits: The run was stopped at 36 of 96 cases (the first 12 of 32 objects in protocol order, which cover three of the eight strata: footwear, thin and flat, and handles and cavities) once the comparison was clear; it is not the full cohort.
Agreement is with original Idol on a selected challenge cohort, not ground-truth 3D accuracy.
Only the Q8 builds at this size were compared. The larger local variants (for example F16 or mixed-precision denoisers, 1.6 to 1.9 GB) were not scored.
Timing was not compared: the GPU and CPU were shared with other workloads during the run.
